fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach both the main residence and detached structures without repositioning.
• Mark or label each detached structure with a visible identifier so responders can quickly distinguish and communicate locations on the property.
• Clear any obstacles along side pathways to allow responders to move between structures without returning to the front of the property.
• Keep side access points on both sides of the residence free of stored items, equipment, or vegetation that narrows the passage.
• Identify and communicate the single access point limitations to your local fire department by requesting a pre-incident walkthrough so responders are familiar with the layout before an emergency.
